install.title: Install the application
install.help: The app installs on your device (icon + dedicated window, like a real program, usable even offline).
install.helpChrome: Chrome / Edge (PC): click the ⊕ “Install” icon in the address bar, or menu ⋮ → “Install GRANDE CAVE”.
